sentences.text: The Regional Dispatch Center handles incoming emergency calls through a controlled intake process that creates an incident record for coordination.
Call Taker Mara is also known by the radio alias Larkspur.
The Hospital Liaison Desk is also known by the coordination alias Kestrel.
Call Taker Mara establishes the caller's location before collecting medical details.
Call Taker Mara asks for the street address, municipality, and any building, floor, or entrance information needed to find the patient.
Call Taker Mara confirms the location by repeating the address and checking it against the caller's description of nearby landmarks.
Call Taker Mara asks whether the caller can provide a callback number in case the connection is lost.
Call Taker Mara gathers the patient's age, level of consciousness, breathing status, and the main reason emergency help is needed.
Call Taker Mara uses direct questions to distinguish observed symptoms from information reported by someone else.
Call Taker Mara records the time symptoms began when the caller can provide a reliable estimate.
Call Taker Mara notes access barriers such as locked entrances, restricted roads, or difficulty reaching the patient.
Call Taker Mara produces the Caller Location Correction Slip when the caller's address needs documented clarification.
The Computer Aided Dispatch Console checks entered location details against available address and map data.
If the location does not resolve cleanly, Call Taker Mara asks focused follow-up questions and updates the incident record.
Call Taker Mara remains engaged with the caller when further information could change the response priority or access plan.
The Hospital Liaison Desk supports intake coordination by confirming facility capabilities and clarifying hospital contact pathways.
The Hospital Liaison Desk checks whether a reported destination preference is compatible with current facility capabilities.
When a facility constraint affects coordination, the Hospital Liaison Desk records the constraint in the incident notes.
The Hospital Liaison Desk produces the Bedside Arrival Receipt when an ambulance arrival has been confirmed.
The Hospital Liaison Desk provides current facility information through established coordination channels without delaying emergency call intake.
The Triage Supervisor reviews incidents when the reported symptoms or uncertainty warrant clinical escalation.
The Data Quality Officer monitors intake records for recurring gaps in location or medical detail.
Call Taker Mara updates the incident record when a caller provides new information before dispatch decisions are finalized.
The Regional Dispatch Center preserves the original caller report alongside subsequent clarifications so responders can distinguish confirmed details from estimates.
